summary: Erase type-only namespace members while keeping value members.

source.pattern: namespace N { export interface I {}; export type T=number; export const x=1 }

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

tests.name: types absent
tests.input: namespace N { export interface I {}; export type T=number; export const x=1 }; console.log((N as any).I,(N as any).T,N.x);

tests.name: value class
tests.input: namespace N { export class C {} }; console.log(typeof N.C);
